parameters.query:
UPDATE campaign_contacts
SET status = 'sent',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.data.id }};

SELECT *
FROM mydatabase.nissan_salesforce
WHERE survey_sent = 0
  AND interes IN ('Warm', 'Hot', 'Cold')
  AND (
    motivo LIKE 'Lead contest%primer mensaje%'
    OR (motivo LIKE 'MELI%' AND interes IN ('Warm', 'Hot'))
  )
  AND updated_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 13 DAY
  AND updated_at < CURDATE();

UPDATE campaign_contacts
SET status = 'failed',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Agregar Contacto').item.json.data.id }};

SELECT *
FROM mydatabase.nissan_salesforce
WHERE survey_sent = 0
  AND interes IN ('Warm', 'Hot')
  AND updated_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY
  AND updated_at < CURDATE();
